nodes.description: Address of the contract owner; set from msg.sender in the constructor and updated in transferOwnership.
Total token supply; set in the DaigouCoin constructor and reduced by burn.
Mapping of address to token balance; mutated by transfer, transferFrom, burn and the constructor.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance; written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
Token name string, set to "Daigou Coin" in the constructor.
Token symbol string, set to "DGR" in the constructor.
Token decimals, fixed to 18 and used in the total supply computation.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, authorization checks and balance bookkeeping.
Ownable constructor assigning msg.sender to owner.
Modifier requiring msg.sender to equal owner; gates transferOwnership and burn.
Owner-only function that transfers contract ownership to newOwner.
Public token transfer using SafeMath add/sub on the balances mapping and msg.sender.
View function returning balances[_owner].
Public allowance-based transfer that debits balances[_from] and allowed[_from][msg.sender].
Public function writing allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _amount.
View function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Owner-only burn reducing balances[msg.sender] and totalSupply.
DaigouCoin constructor that sets owner, name, symbol, totalSupply and initial balances for the wallet.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts any received ether.
View helper returning name, symbol and totalSupply.

SafeMath division.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns the caller-controlled msg.sender to the owner state variable.
The Ownable constructor reads msg.sender to establish initial ownership.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner.
The onlyOwner modifier reads the owner state variable for the authorization check.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
The newOwner parameter drives the ownership transfer logic.
transferOwnership writes the newOwner parameter into the owner state variable.
transfer debits and credits balances using msg.sender as the implicit sender.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
The _to parameter is the recipient address in transfer.
The _amount parameter determines how many tokens are moved in transfer.
transfer performs SafeMath.sub on balances[msg.sender].
transfer performs SafeMath.add on balances[_to].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
The _owner parameter selects the balance entry returned by balanceOf.
transferFrom uses msg.sender to read and decrement allowed[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom reads and writes the allowed allowance mapping.
The _from parameter identifies the debited account in transferFrom.
The _to parameter identifies the credited account in transferFrom.
The _amount parameter drives the amount checks and transfers in transferFrom.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom subtracts token amounts from balances and allowance.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller as the allowance owner.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
The _spender parameter is the account receiving the allowance in approve.
The _amount parameter is the allowance value written by approve.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
The _owner parameter indexes the allowance query.
The _spender parameter indexes the allowance query.
burn is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
burn reads and debits balances[msg.sender].
The _value parameter determines how many tokens are burned.
burn writes the balances mapping.
burn reduces the totalSupply state variable.
burn performs SafeMath.sub on balances and totalSupply.
The wallet constructor parameter becomes the owner of the token contract.
The DaigouCoin constructor assigns the wallet parameter to the owner state variable.
The constructor emits a Transfer event to msg.sender.
The constructor multiplies the base supply by 10**decimals to compute totalSupply.
The DaigouCoin constructor writes the totalSupply state variable.
The DaigouCoin constructor credits the wallet balance in the balances mapping.
decimals is read to scale the initial token supply.
The constructor sets the name state variable.
The constructor sets the symbol state variable.
The payable fallback unconditionally executes revert.
getTokenDetail returns the name state variable.
getTokenDetail returns the symbol state variable.
getTokenDetail returns the totalSupply state variable.
SafeMath.mul computes a * b which is an overflow-sensitive multiplication.
SafeMath.sub computes a - b for the balance subtraction path.
SafeMath.add computes a + b for the balance addition path.
Parameter a flows into the SafeMath.mul computation.
Parameter b flows into the SafeMath.mul computation.
Local product c is assigned inside SafeMath.mul.
Parameter a flows into the SafeMath.div computation.
Parameter b flows into the SafeMath.div computation.
Local quotient c is assigned inside SafeMath.div.
Parameter a flows into the SafeMath.sub computation.
Parameter b flows into the SafeMath.sub computation.
Parameter a flows into the SafeMath.add computation.
Parameter b flows into the SafeMath.add computation.
Local sum c is assigned inside SafeMath.add.

normalization_plan.reason: The newOwner parameter exists only to parameterize transferOwnership and carries ownership-transfer semantics.
The wallet parameter is consumed entirely by the DaigouCoin constructor to set owner, supply and balances.
The _to parameter only affects the transfer function's balance update and event.
The _amount parameter only affects the transfer function's arithmetic and event.
The _owner parameter is only an index used by balanceOf.
The _from parameter only selects the debited account inside transferFrom.
The _to parameter only selects the credited account inside transferFrom.
The _amount parameter only drives checks and debits inside transferFrom.
The _spender parameter is only used as the allowance key in approve.
The _amount parameter is only the value written by approve.
The _owner parameter is only an index used by allowance.
The _spender parameter is only an index used by allowance.
The _value parameter only determines the burn subtraction amount.
Operand a is only meaningful within the SafeMath.mul computation.
Operand b is only meaningful within the SafeMath.mul computation.
Operand a is only meaningful within the SafeMath.div computation.
Operand b is only meaningful within the SafeMath.div computation.
Operand a is only meaningful within the SafeMath.sub computation.
Operand b is only meaningful within the SafeMath.sub computation.
Operand a is only meaningful within the SafeMath.add computation.
Operand b is only meaningful within the SafeMath.add computation.
The local product c is confined to SafeMath.mul and feeds its overflow assertion.
The local quotient c is confined to SafeMath.div.
The local sum c is confined to SafeMath.add and feeds its overflow assertion.
